meta_doc_type_001.evidence: Negotiated Agreement between Prince George’s County Educators’ Association and the Board of Education of Prince George’s County

meta_bargaining_unit_003.evidence: This Agreement affects those certificated employees who are members of Unit I, hereinafter referred to as “Unit I employee.”

meta_document_scope_004.evidence: This Agreement, when ratified and duly signed by the President of the PGCEA, the Executive Director of the PGCEA, the Chairperson of the Board and the Superintendent shall be valid and binding for the duration of this Agreement.

meta_cites_state_law_006.evidence: In accordance with Education Article, Annotated Code of Maryland, Section 6-410
